description: NICFPS (Near-Infrared Camera and Fabry-Perot Spectrometer) was a cryogenic astronomical instrument on the ARC 3.5-meter telescope at Apache Point Observatory, utilizing a Rockwell Hawaii-1RG detector for near-infrared imaging (0.85 to 2.5 microns) and Fabry-Perot spectroscopy. Its filter set includes Mauna Kea broad-band filters and specialized narrow-band lines.
facility_description: The ARC 3.5-meter Telescope is an optical and infrared telescope at Apache Point Observatory (APO) in the Sacramento Mountains of New Mexico, owned and operated by the Astrophysical Research Consortium.
notes: NICFPS filters were semi-permanently mounted inside the dewar at 77 K. Specifications and cryogenic traces are hosted by CASA at the University of Colorado Boulder and APO without an open redistribution licence.
